scope: Freeze these dimensions and case-specific source obligations before unseen evaluation; this record selects no unseen batch.

dimensions.name: relevant_evidence_coverage
dimensions.assessment: For each preregistered obligation, record relevant retained evidence, delivery and report use separately; report denominator and capture gaps.

dimensions.name: interpretation_correctness
dimensions.assessment: Review every material proposition against source, preserving subject, operation, polarity, version and timing; distinguish unsupported from contradicted.

dimensions.name: unsupported_claims
dimensions.assessment: Count and identify unsupported factual assertions/inferences across claims, summary, conditions and recommendation; an existing/delivered citation is insufficient.

dimensions.name: scoped_negative_evidence
dimensions.assessment: Check query mode, source/path scope, retained capture omissions, offsets, page completeness and the exact absence proposition; reject generalization beyond scope.

dimensions.name: unresolved_quality
dimensions.assessment: Distinguish decision-critical missing observations from vague caution, unnecessary unknowns and claims presented as known despite gaps.

dimensions.name: stopping_quality
dimensions.assessment: Assess whether stopping follows sufficient evidence, decision-critical missing evidence or a resource/contract boundary; preserve missed feasible investigations.

dimensions.name: recommendation_usefulness
dimensions.assessment: Judge supported specificity and actionable conditions for the maintainer; retain valid abstention/unresolved advice. Requires independent reviewer for unseen acceptance.

dimensions.name: reviewer_effort
dimensions.assessment: Record actual active review time and corrections/ambiguities, separately from inference runtime. Assisted known-case review is labelled; unknown measurements remain unknown.

dimensions.name: resource_cost
dimensions.assessment: Account every attempt, tokens including reasoning, operations, observation/provided-packet bytes, elapsed time, corrections, truncation, packing and unknown usage.

aggregation: Per-case and per-claim profiles; no weighted composite or winner inference is admitted. Model identity, policy, corpus and reviewer assistance remain visible.
